about: An exit says its words to the one who takes it, before the place they arrive in, and to nobody else; the exit that applies is the one that speaks, so the way down says one thing until the rope is tied and a passage of the roof after; a way refused at its destination says nothing of itself, and a way with no `say` says nothing.
